summary: YPF S.A., an Argentine oil company filing a Form 6-K, announced the early redemption of its Class XXXV Notes (US$139.9M nominal, 6.25% fixed rate, maturing Feb 27, 2027) at par plus accrued interest, effective Aug 27, 2026. The company will issue class XLIII notes as payment in kind, reducing outstanding Class XXXV Notes to US$134.5M. Redemption is at US$1 per US$1 nominal value with US$0.0158 interest per US$1, paid through Caja de Valores S.A. This routine debt redemption is a standard financing activity rather than a special-situation corporate event.
